rules.title: Explicit mappings
rules.text: Define explicit mappings and choose keyword or text deliberately instead of relying on dynamic mapping.

rules.title: Not the source of truth
rules.text: Treat the search index as derived data that can be rebuilt from the primary store.

rules.title: Avoid deep pagination
rules.text: Paginate beyond 10,000 hits with search_after, using a point in time for stable order, instead of large from and size values.

rules.title: Reindex behind aliases
rules.text: Query through index aliases so you can reindex and swap without downtime.

rules.title: Use the bulk API
rules.text: Index in batches with the bulk API and handle per-item failures.
